Pakistan’s unelected and fascist-appointed Finance Minister Aurangzeb may once have led one of the country’s biggest banks to success — but now risks being remembered for presiding over one of its most serious financial downturns. A nation cannot be held together by temporary fixes, financial camouflage, and band-aid solutions that merely delay real structural reform — all while propping up an unelected, increasingly authoritarian system. There could have been an opportunity to overhaul critical sectors and chart a stronger, more sustainable course. Instead, constrained leadership and questionable governance have stifled meaningful progress — considering he almost had carte blanche from the ultimate powers that be — but it seems he only helped lead a begging bowl around the world for Pakistan with barely anything to show for inside the country. A strong CV may open doors, but it does not guarantee results. Leadership is ultimately judged by delivery — and when that falls short, accountability should follow. But once done and dusted, he will be used and abused and return to his bank hereafter — while time was wasted for Pakistan and the 260 million Pakistanis like me.

The IAEA has been informed by Iran that a projectile struck close to the premises of the Bushehr NPP this morning, the fourth such incident in recent weeks. Iran also informed the IAEA that one of the site’s physical protection staff members was killed by a projectile fragment and that a building on site was affected by shockwaves and fragments. No increase in radiation levels was reported. IAEA DG @rafaelmgrossi expresses deep concern about the reported incident and says NPP sites or nearby areas must never be attacked, noting that auxiliary site buildings may contain vital safety equipment. Reiterating call for maximum military restraint to avoid risk of a nuclear accident, DG Grossi again stresses the paramount importance of adhering to the 7 pillars for ensuring nuclear safety and security during a conflict.

The Chengdu-Guiyang high-speed railway is a striking example of China's engineering prowess and infrastructure development. As the world's first high-speed railway built in mountainous terrain, it passes through karst landscapes, gas-filled caves, landslide zones and debris flow areas. With bridges and tunnels accounting for 81.5% of the route, it has been described as "a railway built inside a geological museum." Linking Sichuan, Yunnan and Guizhou, the railway has strengthened western China's transport network and benefited more than 36 million people. It also ended the long history of no rail access in places such as Zhenxiong and Weixin in Yunnan, helping remote mountain areas connect more closely with regional development. More importantly, it has transformed daily life. Travel time between Chengdu and Guiyang has been cut from nearly 20 hours to less than 3, boosting mobility, trade, tourism and rural revitalization along the route. #ChinaSeen #transport (Photos via VCG)

Russian forces attacked a market in the city of Nikopol, Dnipropetrovsk Oblast, with a drone this morning, the regional prosecutor’s office reported. Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 है जिसमें 2018 में संशोधन हुआ। ⦿ इस एक्ट के सेक्शन-3 के क्लॉज F के तहत मुकदमा दर्ज होना चाहिए, क्योंकि दबंगों ने पीड़ित परिवार को उनकी फसल तक नहीं काटने दी। ⦿ समझौते का दवाब बनाने के लिए झूठा केस दर्ज कराया गया, तो इसके आधार पर भी सेक्शन P में मुकदमा बनता है, जो पुलिस ने नहीं लगाया। ⦿ सेक्शन 4 के अनुसार शिकायत देने के बाद भी पुलिस के अधिकारी कार्रवाई नहीं करते हैं, तो उन अधिकारियों के खिलाफ भी मुकदमा बनता है। ⦿ इस मामले में ASP ने SP को आरोपियों की गिरफ्तारी की झूठी जानकारी दी, इसलिए ASP पर भी मुकदमा बनता है। ⦿ सेक्शन-15(A) के तहत पीड़िता को संरक्षण देने की जिम्मेदारी सरकार की है। पीड़िता का बयान 17 मार्च को दर्ज होना था, लेकिन उसे कोई पुलिस प्रोटेक्शन नहीं मिली। इसके तहत भी मुकदमा बनता है। अगर सेक्शन-15(A) का पालन ठीक से हुआ होता, तो पीड़िता के परिजनों पर जानलेवा हमला न होता। : कांग्रेस SC विभाग के चेयरमैन @AdvRajendraPal जी 📍 दिल्ली Video

For the people of the Han Dynasty (202 BC–220 AD), death was not the end of existence. The body might perish, but the soul, they believed, continued on. The silk painting below, known as Feiyi, or "non-garment," is one of the most remarkable discoveries from the Mawangdui Han tombs in central China's Hunan Province. It presents a vision of the soul's journey after death. Measuring 205 centimeters long, the painting takes a distinctive T-shaped form and is divided into three realms: heaven above, the human world in the middle, and the underworld below. At its center stands the tomb occupant – an elderly woman leaning on a walking stick – shown in the act of ascending toward the heavens. In Han funerary practice, this was far more than decoration: it was a sacred object at the heart of the burial rite. Now preserved in the Hunan Museum, the painting reveals how Han people envisioned both the fate of the soul and the order of the cosmos. It is therefore an indispensable source for understanding Han conceptions of life, death and the universe. State Dept and CENTCOM ops have confirmed military airlifts and charters pulling out personnel and civilians from damaged bases/hotels since early March, with round trips enabling that scale. Logistics match the surge we saw—evac priority over buildup at this stage.

To evacuate 5,000–10,000 scattered US personnel/civilians from smashed bases/hotels in a contested area: It would take a major NEO (noncombatant evacuation operation) involving 40–80+ heavy-lift sorties (C-17s ~100 pax each, C-130s ~80, plus C-5s). Add fighter escorts, tankers, ISR, and ground teams for pickup. US Air Mobility Command has 300+ strategic/tactical airlifters and can surge that scale in 48–96 hours if air/sea lanes are viable—similar to Kabul 2021 but riskier if threats persist. Sealift (amphibious ships) could supplement if ports allow. Logistics depend on the exact theater.

They all reduce to the same 3 steps: (i) clone the repo; (ii) enter it as a workspace; (iii) tell StatsClaw where you want to develop your software or where existing software is located. My personal routine: (a) Clone the package repo to a local folder. (b) Symlink it to the StatsClaw workspace. This keeps the package repo and the StatsClaw repo clean and separate.

Sigh Shanaka Anslem Perera ⚡ (@shanaka86) BREAKING: The E-4B Nightwatch, the aircraft the Pentagon calls the National Airborne Operations Center and the press calls the Doomsday Plane, landed at Joint Base Andrews on April 3 after departing Offutt Air Force Base in Nebraska. The President’s briefings were cancelled. National security meetings were convened. On the same day, the first American fighter jet was shot down over Iran, ceasefire talks collapsed, and the largest visible airlift of the war began crossing the Atlantic. The E-4B is a modified 747 hardened against electromagnetic pulse, carrying a battle staff of over 100, designed to serve as an airborne command post if ground communications are destroyed. Four exist. They rotate so one is always within minutes of the President. When one moves from Offutt to Andrews, it positions closer to the White House. The movement is technically routine. The timing is not. C-17 Globemaster transports are crossing the Atlantic in waves, supported by KC-135 Stratotankers, carrying troops, armoured vehicles, and heavy equipment to staging bases in Europe and the eastern Mediterranean. OSINT flight tracking confirms a second wave over Europe heading toward the Gulf. Over 100 C-17 sorties have been observed since the war began, but the April 3 movement is the largest single visible surge. The airlift predates the F-15E loss. The acceleration does not. Here is what the movement means when placed against the day it occurred. The F-15E was shot down and the weapons systems officer is missing. The A-10 took fire and crashed in Kuwait. The rescue helicopters were hit by small arms. Iran rejected the ceasefire and called US demands unacceptable. The Pakistan channel is dead. The 48-hour ceasefire proposal was rejected. Vance’s back-channel produced no breakthrough. The April 6 power-plant deadline expires Monday evening. Markets close today and do not reopen until Monday morning. And the Doomsday Plane is at Andrews. The E-4B does not mean nuclear escalation is imminent. It means the National Command Authority wants its airborne command post within range of the President during a weekend in which every variable in the war shifted simultaneously. The fighter is down. The diplomacy is dead. The deadline is live. The airlift is surging. And the aircraft designed to survive the end of communications is parked at the base closest to the man who decides what happens next. Three generals were fired this week. Twenty-six officers in fourteen months. The Army Chief was replaced without explanation by a general whose primary credential is carrying the nuclear briefcase. The chain of command was reshaped before the worst day of the war, not after. The E-4B landed after. The sequence matters: you clear the chain of command first, then you position the aircraft that executes through it. Nobody connects these threads because each has a routine explanation. The E-4B moves regularly. The C-17s have flown since February. The generals were fired for “efficiency.” The deadline has been postponed twice. But routine stops being routine when every thread converges on the same 72 hours in which an American pilot is missing, the ceasefire is dead, the power-plant strikes are scheduled, and the Doomsday Plane is at Andrews. The weekend has no market. The deadline has no extension. The pilot has no confirmed rescue. IRAN’S SHOOTDOWN OF U.S. F-15 & A-10 EXPLAINED 🚨 1. Five weeks into the war, the United States and Israel claim overwhelming air superiority over Iran. Yet the latest shootdowns tell a more complicated story. An F-15 strike fighter and an A-10 Warthog have both been downed and two Black Hawk CSAR helicopters were hit during rescue operations. 2. These incidents demonstrate that Iranian air defences are still functioning despite more than a month of relentless bombing of radars, SAM sites and command networks. Hostile airspace clearly still exists over parts of Iran. 3. Iran appears to have shifted to what can best be described as air defence guerrilla warfare. Mobile launchers, pop up radars, improvised sensor sites and shoot and scoot missile teams that appear briefly, fire and disappear before counterstrikes arrive. Coupled with US fighters now flying lower and slower to pick out ‘missed’ air defence elements possibly creates targeting opportunities for Iran that didn’t exist thus far. 4. Highly mobile systems such as Khordad and Majid launchers combined with shoulder fired missile teams make the battlespace unpredictable, especially for aircraft forced to descend lower to hunt for targets. 5. Iran’s decentralised command structure means air defence does not collapse even if central nodes are destroyed. Many provinces operate semi autonomous air defence sectors that can fight independently. 6. The shootdown of an F-15 and an A-10 indicates that even non stealth aircraft operating with coalition support are still facing lethal engagement envelopes. That is a major indicator that suppression of enemy air defences is incomplete. 7. The passive sensor approach reportedly used in attempts to track stealth aircraft has been a wake up call as well. Even the possibility that Iranian networks are detecting F-35s through passive triangulation or offboard cues has forced tactical caution. 8. The CSAR story is outright remarkable. Combat search and rescue operations were launched immediately after the shootdowns and despite two Black Hawk helicopters taking hits, almost all pilots from the F-15 and A-10 incidents were successfully rescued. That alone is an extraordinary display of aviation courage & coordination under the most unpredictable kind of fire. 9. These aircraft losses also follow Iran’s strikes against high value assets. Earlier attacks hit AWACS and tanker aircraft on the ground and most recently a Chinook helicopter was struck in Kuwait. Iran clearly understands that targeting sensors and logistics aircraft has outsized operational impact. 10.Taken together, the pattern suggests Iran cannot deny the skies entirely but can still contest them. That is a very different reality from the sweeping claims of total air domination heard repeatedly from Washington. 11. Hostile airspace is a chaotic domain with millions of moving parts. Aircraft, radars, missiles, drones, electronic warfare and human decisions interacting every second. 12. Losing 2 frontline fighters in hostile engagements 5 weeks into a war that has been otherwise marked by successful airstrikes and thousands of combat sorties is no sleep-killer. It is only perhaps surprising that such shootdowns didn’t happen sooner. 12. But when grandiose claims of absolute air domination are paired with taunts from the Pentagon and the White House, successful hits on frontline aircraft like the F-15 and A-10 are no small feat. And they underline one uncomfortable truth. Air domination over Iran is far from total.

Over the past two decades, from the U.S. invasion of Afghanistan to the Russia–Ukraine war and now the Iran conflict, it has become increasingly clear that modern wars are far more difficult to sustain and carry far deeper geo-economic consequences than earlier conflicts. These wars no longer remain confined to battlefields; they disrupt global energy supplies, drive inflation, strain supply chains, and impact economies far beyond the regions where they are fought. Recent developments have shown how quickly conflicts can trigger global energy shocks and economic instability, affecting even distant countries through rising fuel prices, food insecurity, and slowing growth. For countries like #India and #Pakistan, there are important lessons to be drawn. Rather than prioritizing prolonged military buildup, greater emphasis could be placed on resolving disputes through dialogue, diplomacy, and third-party mediation. Both nations still face significant development challenges, with large segments of their populations living below optimal standards of living. Redirecting resources toward economic growth, infrastructure, and social development may ultimately yield far more sustainable security than continued escalation.

कांग्रेस के शासनकाल में देश के 126 जिले नक्सलवाद की आग में जल रहे थे। उस दौर में सरकार ने नक्सलियों से हथियार डलवाने का साहस दिखाने की बजाय खुद ही हार मान ली और यह मान बैठी कि इस समस्या का कोई समाधान नहीं है। 2014 में जब मोदी सरकार सत्ता में आई, तो एक ऐतिहासिक संकल्प लिया गया, 31 मार्च 2026 तक भारत पूर्णतः नक्सलमुक्त होगा, और आज वह संकल्प साकार हो चुका है। भारत नक्सलमुक्त है। जहां कभी गोलियों और बारूद का खौफ था, आज वहां 12,000 किलोमीटर सड़कों का जाल बिछ चुका है। 6,000 करोड़ रुपये की लागत से स्थापित 9,000 मोबाइल टावर उन दुर्गम क्षेत्रों को दुनिया से जोड़ रहे हैं, जो कभी अंधेरे में डूबे थे। पिछले 12 वर्षों में इन क्षेत्रों की आर्थिक रीढ़ को भी मजबूत किया गया है... 1,804 बैंक शाखाएं, 1,321 ATM, 37,850 बैंकिंग कॉरेस्पोंडेंट और 625 डाकघर आज उन लोगों तक वित्तीय सेवाएं पहुंचा रहे हैं, जो कभी व्यवस्था से कटे हुए थे। जब नेतृत्व मजबूत हो, नीयत साफ हो और इरादे अडिग हों, तो डर नहीं, विश्वास जीतता है… और असंभव भी संभव हो जाता है। 🇮🇳 Video

CÓMO EL CEREBRO AJUSTA EL MIEDO: CLAVES PARA NUEVAS TERAPIAS CONTRA EL ESTRÉS POSTRAUMÁTICO Según un estudio recientemente divulgado, el cerebro no “elimina” el miedo de manera abrupta cuando desaparece una amenaza, sino que ajusta progresivamente su funcionamiento mediante la acción coordinada de distintas neuronas en la amígdala central. El equipo del Instituto del Cerebro de Tulane dirigido por el neurocientífico Jonathan Fadok describió los mecanismos responsables de este ajuste y su relevancia para el trastorno de estrés postraumático, de acuerdo con el estudio publicado en la revista médica The Journal of Neuroscience. “Esto ha sido increíblemente útil, pero solo abarca una parte del panorama”, afirmó. Según su visión, cuando una amenaza desaparece, el cerebro reajusta las respuestas de miedo a través de circuitos neuronales que gradualmente modifican las conductas defensivas, como pasar de una huida a la inmovilidad. Este proceso no borra el miedo por completo, sino que lo reconfigura para adaptarse al nuevo contexto y a las experiencias previas. Infobae 🔗 infob.ae/4vbejEO

EL “MAPA EMOCIONAL” DEL CEREBRO: ASÍ SE ORGANIZAN LOS SENTIMIENTOS, SEGÚN UN ESTUDIO Un estudio reciente ha demostrado que el cerebro humano organiza las emociones en un “mapa emocional” estructurado en regiones específicas, según detalló Muy Interesante. Investigadores de la Universidad de Emory han identificado que distintas zonas cerebrales agrupan sentimientos concretos siguiendo una lógica espacial, lo que supone un cambio fundamental en la comprensión científica de las emociones y su relación con la salud mental. El hallazgo revela que las emociones humanas no se distribuyen de manera abstracta, sino que se agrupan en áreas precisas del cerebro. Esta cartografía emocional permite explicar por qué ciertos sentimientos se presentan juntos y favorece la búsqueda de nuevas terapias para trastornos como la ansiedad y la depresión. For the longest time, Computer Science jobs were reduced to learning the syntax of a programming language to work as a software developer. The sellable skill, therefore, was essentially knowledge of syntax, and tedium of writing and debugging code ... AI had made this skill (almost) redundant. Now you need systems designers and solution architects who understand advanced computer science concepts and know how to apply underlying theoretical principles. AI will generate the code for you. However, in many universities (perhaps most in a country like Pakistan), these skills are not taught well. There's no "upskilling" of coding skills that'd change this -- universities need to produce great computer scientists, not good programmers. Take a look at my favourite computer science course at MIT from back in the day: 6.033. That's the style of curriculum university students need to master ...

The Abraham Lincoln CSG is operating from an undisclosed location in the Arabian Sea and conducting nonstop combat operations against Iran. The Tripoli ARG and 31st MEU arrived in CENTCOM last week, and the Boxer ARG and 11th MEU are transiting the Pacific en route to the Middle East. 1. #CutTheClutter steps away from the war in the Gulf. It’s not about what’s happening in the battlefield, but its consequences, particularly for the ordinary Indian citizen — specifically the distress over LPG. This episode looks at India’s LPG & LNG imports, consumption and production. 2. If the war continues, other stress points, like fuel prices, will emerge. For now, there’s elections, but April 28 onwards, watch out for those prices. The reason is quite simple: India imports almost 90% of its crude oil needs. And, if anything, our production has been falling for the past many years, since 2011. 3. India is heavily dependent on imports for LPG. We have 32cr households that use LPG, but we produce only about 30-35%. And, nearly 90% of our imports is from the Gulf — UAE (36.5%), Qatar (21.4%), Kuwait (16%) & Saudi Arabia (14%). Most of our domestic production is as a byproduct of crude distillation at oil refineries, which govt has now asked to be increased. 4. On PNG, India is better placed. Only 1.5cr households use it & we also produce about 50%. Some of it comes from the Krishna Godavari basin, where a couple of more wells are being dug & the hope is that gas production will go up. But PNG is available elsewhere in the world, so India is not so dependent on the Gulf countries. 5. The govt assures us every day that they have enough LPG, the arrival of every tanker is celebrated in headlines. It’s almost like the 1960s. Then there were news items on front pages saying 2 more ships with wheat have arrived from the US. That was a ship-to-mouth existence. Today, it’s tanker-to-burner. 6. Parts of the world that produce hydrocarbons are prone to instability, so this uncertainty will continue — it’s already hit 5 times in my lifetime. Every 10-15 years, there will be an energy crisis in the world. So, how does a country like India get around it? 7. Hon’ble Raksha Mantri, Shri Rajnath Singh today visited Naval Science & Technological Laboratory (NSTL) , DRDO and laid the foundation stone for the state-of-the-art Large Cavitation Tunnel (LCT) facility. Conceived as a strategic national asset, the LCT facility is a significant step in strengthening indigenous capabilities in hydrodynamic research, aimed at supporting the design and development of next-generation ships, submarines and underwater platforms. The upcoming LCT facility is poised to emerge as a globally unique infrastructure with its capability to conduct both closed-loop simulations essential for submarine studies and free surface simulations critical for surface ship research within a single integrated setup The facility once operational, will significantly enhance the country’s shipbuilding ecosystem by enabling precise validation of hydrodynamic designs and propulsion systems for major naval platforms During the visit of Hon’ble RM , various advanced naval systems and technologies developed by NSTL were also showcased including live demonstration of swarm Autonomous Underwater Vehicles (AUVs). During the visit, Chief of Defence Staff Gen Anil Chauhan, Chief of the Naval Staff Admiral Dinesh K Tripathi, Secretary DDR&D and Chairman DRDO Dr Samir V Kamat, FoC-in-C, East Vice Admiral Sanjay Bhalla , Dr. R. V. Haraprasad Director General ( Naval Systems and Materials), Dr.Abraham Varughese Director NSTL and senior officials from DRDO & IN were also present

Driven by a focus on improving the quality of life and well-being of Sailors, the Wi-Fi expansion has seen rapid adoption, with 70.5 percent of residents in available buildings registered for the service as of February. A continuous survey of residents shows an 84 percent overall satisfaction rate reflecting the program’s success. “This initiative is a direct reflection of our unwavering commitment to the well-being of our Sailors,” said Vice Adm. Scott Gray, Commander, Navy Installations Command. “Providing free, high-speed Wi-Fi is a fundamental step in improving their quality of life, ensuring they have the connectivity they need for personal and professional growth. We are dedicated to delivering the resources that support our warfighters, and this program is a testament to that promise.”

In March, the Russian army in Ukraine suffered losses of more than 35,000 soldiers killed or seriously wounded. This is the highest figure since the start of the full-scale war, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said following a report by Defense Minister Mykhailo Fedorov. 33,988 Russian soldiers were reportedly killed or seriously wounded by drone strikes alone, and another 1,363 Russians were killed by artillery and other strikes. All these losses are “clearly confirmed,” Zelenskyy says, as there is video evidence of each such strike. Volodymyr Zelenskyy / Володимир Зеленський (@ZelenskyyUa) Russian losses this March have reached their highest level since the start of the war: our drone strikes alone resulted in 33,988 Russian servicemembers killed or seriously wounded, while artillery and other strikes eliminated another 1,363 Russian occupiers. That means more than 35,000 Russian losses in just one month – and these are clearly verified losses. We have video documentation of every such strike in our system. I thank all our warriors for their precision. I will especially recognize the warriors of the Special Operations Center “A” of Ukraine’s Security Service, the “Magyar's Birds,” the State Border Guard Service special unit “Phoenix,” “Lasar’s Group,” and the 95th Separate Airborne Assault Brigade – these are the most effective units in the use of drones. The Minister of Defense of Ukraine, Mykhailo Fedorov, briefed me on the performance of all units at the front. We have clear and verified reports for every direction and every type of strike. We are ready to provide the relevant data to our partners. Essentially, Ukraine’s Defense and Security Forces have denied the occupier the ability to dictate the situation on the front line. Importantly, the results in the destruction of Russia’s air defense systems have also significantly increased, with 274 such systems hit in March alone. There have also been tangible results in the destruction of Russian depots and military logistics. The Ministry of Defense, together with the Armed Forces, will present a detailed report to the public for March – data that may be made public. I also approved with the Minister today a number of tasks for the coming weeks. In particular, we are preparing decisions to strengthen the Ukrainian infantry, the army contract system, and measures to address AWOL cases – measures that must genuinely work in practice. We are also preparing decisions to scale up the export opportunities of our weapons manufacturers and joint productions with partners. I thank our Defense Forces for the results! The President informed me that Egypt will no longer accept grain exported by Russia from our temporarily occupied territories and is, at the same time, interested in increasing imports of grain from Ukraine. I am grateful for this decision. Egypt is also ready to contribute to achieving a dignified peace. We agreed that our foreign ministers will remain in contact. We discussed the situation in the Middle East and the Gulf, as well as its impact on the global oil market. I updated the President on our meetings and agreements with countries in the region. Ukraine has significant potential for military-technical cooperation, and we are ready to work in this direction with Egypt as well. We also went over other areas for developing bilateral cooperation between our countries. We will continue working on this.

জাতীয় ক্রীড়া সম্মাননা অনুষ্ঠানে বাংলাদেশ সেনাবাহিনী দলের উজ্জ্বল সাফল্য ঢাকা, ৩০ মার্চ ২০২৬ (সোমবার): আজ প্রধানমন্ত্রীর কার্যালয়ের শাপলা হলে অনুষ্ঠিত ক্রীড়া ভাতা ও স্পোর্টস কার্ড বিতরণ কর্মসূচির উদ্বোধনী অনুষ্ঠানে বাংলাদেশ সেনাবাহিনীর ক্রীড়াবিদদের উল্লেখযোগ্য উপস্থিতি ও সাফল্য বিশেষভাবে প্রতিফলিত হয়। মাননীয় প্রধানমন্ত্রী জনাব তারেক রহমান অনুষ্ঠানের উদ্বোধন করেন এবং আন্তর্জাতিক পর্যায়ে কৃতিত্ব অর্জনকারী ক্রীড়াবিদগণের মাঝে পুরস্কার প্রদান করেন। অনুষ্ঠানে অংশগ্রহণকারী মোট ১২৯ জন ক্রীড়াবিদের মধ্যে বাংলাদেশ সেনাবাহিনীর ২৫ জন খেলোয়াড় (১৪ জন পুরুষ ও ১১ জন নারী) অন্তর্ভুক্ত ছিলেন, যারা ক্রীড়াক্ষেত্রে বিশেষ নৈপুণ্য প্রদর্শনের স্বীকৃতিস্বরূপ সম্মাননা লাভ করেন। পরবর্তী ধাপে ক্রীড়া ভাতা কর্মসূচির আওতায় আরও প্রায় ৫০০ জন ক্রীড়াবিদ অন্তর্ভুক্ত হবে, যার মাধ্যমে বাংলাদেশ সেনাবাহিনীর আরও অধিক সংখ্যক খেলোয়াড় ক্রীড়া ভাতার আওতায় আসবে বলে প্রত্যাশা করা হচ্ছে। উল্লেখ্য, ২০২৫ সালে বাংলাদেশ সেনাবাহিনীর ক্রীড়াবিদরা আন্তর্জাতিক প্রতিযোগিতায় মোট ৪৩টি পদক অর্জন করেছে। এছাড়া বিভিন্ন জাতীয় দলে বাংলাদেশ সেনাবাহিনী সর্বমোট ৩৯৫ জন খেলোয়াড় প্রদান করেছে, যা দেশের ক্রীড়া অঙ্গনে সেনাবাহিনীর গুরুত্বপূর্ণ অবদানের প্রতিফলন।

A Chinese video by “Laohu Talks World” is going viral online, breaking down how Iran could try to target the F-35 Lightning II using existing equipment by simplifying the problem step by step. The speaker argues that air combat isn’t realistic given Iran’s aging fleet, including decades-old Grumman F-14 Tomcats, and instead focuses on ground-based air defense. He contrasts large systems like the S-300 and Bavar-373 with smaller, mobile systems like the Majid air defense system, arguing that lighter, decentralized setups using infrared tracking could be harder to detect and survive longer. The video is part of a wider phenomenon from China as the Middle East conflict unfolds: civilians are volunteering, without pay, their technical skills on social media to help Iran counter U.S. military power. தேசிய ஜனநாயகக் கூட்டணி BEST புதுச்சேரியை உருவாக்கப் பாடுபடும் வேளையில், எதிர்க்கட்சிக்குப் புதுச்சேரியின் முன்னேற்றம் குறித்து எந்தத் தொலைநோக்குப் பார்வையும் இல்லை. அவர்கள் மக்களின் விருப்பத்திற்கு செவிசாய்ப்பதற்கு பதிலாக, புதுச்சேரியை ஒரு ஏடிஎம் போலப் பயன்படுத்தி, தில்லியில் உள்ள உயர் தலைமை ஆட்சியின் கீழ் அது இருப்பதை உறுதி செய்ய விரும்புகிறார்கள். சில நாட்களுக்கு முன், நான் புதுச்சேரி பிஜேபி வாக்குச்சாவடி முகவர்களுடன் உரையாடிக் கொண்டிருந்தேன். அப்போது எமது கட்சியின் செயல்வீரர் ஒருவர், எதிர்க்கட்சியின் நோக்கம் ஒரு WEAK புதுச்சேரியை உருவாக்குவதே என்று மிகச் சரியாகவே கூறினார். அவர் WEAK என்று கூறியதன் பொருள் இதுதான்: W- மோசமாக நிர்வாகம் செய்தல் E- வளர்ச்சிக்கு முடிவு கட்டுதல் A - மக்களுக்கு எதிராக இருத்தல் K- பொருளாதாரத்தை அழித்தல்

Російські втрати за цей березень вийшли на рівень, що став найбільшим за час війни: тільки завдяки ударам наших дронів загинули або були важко поранені 33988 російських військових і ще 1363 окупанти були ліквідовані завдяки артилерійським та іншим ударам. Тобто вже більше 35 тисяч російських втрат за місяць, і це чітко підтверджені втрати: у нас в системі є відеофіксація кожного такого ураження. Дякую всім нашим воїнам за влучність. Відзначу особливо воїнів ЦСО «А» Служби безпеки України, «Птахів Мадяра», спецпідрозділ прикордонників «Фенікс», Lazar’s Group і 95-ту окрему десантно-штурмову бригаду: це найбільш результативні підрозділи в застосуванні дронів. Міністр оборони України Михайло Федоров доповів про результати всіх підрозділів на фронті: у нас є чіткі та перевірені звіти по кожному напрямку та по кожній категорії уражень. Ми готові надати відповідні дані нашим партнерам. Фактично Сили оборони та безпеки України позбавили окупанта можливості навʼязувати характер ситуації на фронті. Важливо, що суттєво збільшились результати в знищенні також систем ППО Росії, а саме 274 такі системи уражено тільки за березень. Є відчутні результати і в знищенні російських складів та військової логістики. Міністерство оборони разом зі Збройними Силами представлять суспільству детальний звіт за березень – дані, які можуть бути публічними. Погодили сьогодні з міністром і ряд завдань на найближчі тижні. Зокрема, готуємо рішення для посилення української піхоти, системи контрактів в армії та реагування щодо СЗЧ – заходи повинні бути такими, що реально спрацюють. Готуємо і рішення, щоб масштабувати експортні можливості наших виробників зброї та спільні виробництва з партнерами. Дякую Силам оборони за результати! Слава Україні!

Russian losses this March have reached their highest level since the start of the war: our drone strikes alone resulted in 33,988 Russian servicemembers killed or seriously wounded, while artillery and other strikes eliminated another 1,363 Russian occupiers. That means more than 35,000 Russian losses in just one month – and these are clearly verified losses. We have video documentation of every such strike in our system. I thank all our warriors for their precision. I will especially recognize the warriors of the Special Operations Center “A” of Ukraine’s Security Service, the “Magyar's Birds,” the State Border Guard Service special unit “Phoenix,” “Lasar’s Group,” and the 95th Separate Airborne Assault Brigade – these are the most effective units in the use of drones. The Minister of Defense of Ukraine, Mykhailo Fedorov, briefed me on the performance of all units at the front. We have clear and verified reports for every direction and every type of strike. We are ready to provide the relevant data to our partners. Essentially, Ukraine’s Defense and Security Forces have denied the occupier the ability to dictate the situation on the front line. Importantly, the results in the destruction of Russia’s air defense systems have also significantly increased, with 274 such systems hit in March alone. There have also been tangible results in the destruction of Russian depots and military logistics. The Ministry of Defense, together with the Armed Forces, will present a detailed report to the public for March – data that may be made public. I also approved with the Minister today a number of tasks for the coming weeks. In particular, we are preparing decisions to strengthen the Ukrainian infantry, the army contract system, and measures to address AWOL cases – measures that must genuinely work in practice. We are also preparing decisions to scale up the export opportunities of our weapons manufacturers and joint productions with partners. I thank our Defense Forces for the results! Glory to Ukraine!

Сьогодні відзначив державними нагородами представників кримськотатарського народу. Я вдячний вам, що ви з Україною. Я дякую кожному, хто бореться за нашу державу, за незалежність України, за наші права й територіальну цілісність. Я підписав указ, який надає більше реальних можливостей, щоб захищати всю Україну й наш Крим – усіх наших людей і корінний народ, кримськотатарський народ, нашу безпеку, наше право жити вільно на своїй землі. Меджліс завжди був і є представницьким органом кримськотатарського народу, так було і є фактично. І ми закріплюємо це юридично й політично, щоб ваші можливості були сильніші і щоб наші спільні українські можливості були сильніші. Треба покласти край російським агресіям, ударам і знущанню. Треба гарантувати всі компоненти безпеки Україні. І ми можемо зробити це тільки спільно – принципово – всі в Україні, всі у Європі, всі у світі. Якщо будемо й надалі максимально ефективними, активними й такими, що не забуваємо уроків минулого. Video

रिकॉर्ड्स को ब्रेक कर दिया था, जो इस साल भी बरकरार है. इस फिल्म की सफलता के बाद दूसरा भाग 19 मार्च को सिनेमाघरों में रिलीज किया गया, जिसमें रिवेंज की कहानी देखने को मिली. ‘धुरंधर द रिवेंज’ के रिलीज होते ही बॉक्स ऑफिस पर तूफान आ गया और फिर ऐसा धमाका हुआ कि कई और पुराने रिकॉर्ड टूट गए. रणवीर सिंह की इस फिल्म ने ‘केजीएफ 2’, ‘बाहुबली 2’, ‘एनिमल’ और ‘स्त्री 2’ जैसी फिल्मों को पछाड़ दिया है. वहीं रिलीज के 15वें दिन ये फिल्म अल्लू अर्जुन की ‘पुष्पा 2’ के वर्ल्डवाइड कलेक्शन को टक्कर देते हुए आगे बढ़ रही है. रणवीर सिंह की ‘धुरंधर 2’ को लेकर फैंस के बीच जबरदस्त एक्साइटमेंट देखी गई, जिसके चलते एडवांस बुकिंग की लंबी लाइनें और थिएटर हाउसफुल देखने को मिले. वहीं इस फिल्म का फीवर रिलीज के 15 दिन बाद भी दिखाई दे रहा है. रणवीर सिंह और डायरेक्टर आदित्य धर की इस ब्लॉकबस्टर जोड़ी ने ये साबित कर दिया कि सीक्वल पहले पार्ट से कई गुना बड़ा और हिट हो सकता है. . . सैकनिल्क रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, ‘धुरंधर 2’ ने पेड प्रीव्यू में ही 43 करोड़ कमा लिए थे, इसके बाद ओपनिंग डे पर ये कलेक्शन बढ़कर 102 करोड़ रुपए के आसपास पहुंच गया था. रणवीर सिंह की इस स्पाई एक्शन फिल्म ने पहले हफ्ते में लगभग 674.17 करोड़ का बिजनेस किया, जिसके बाद दूसरे हफ्ते फिल्म ने महज 263.65 करोड़ रुपए की कमाई की. 15वें दिन तक ओवरऑल नेट कलेक्शन की अगर बात करें, तो फिल्म ‘धुरंधर 2’ ने 937.82 करोड़ रुपए का आंकड़ा पार कर लिया है. रणवीर सिंह की फिल्म ‘धुरंधर’ ने बॉक्स ऑफिस पर 1300 करोड़ रुपए से ज्यादा का बिजनेस किया था, जिसके बाद इस फिल्म के दूसरे भाग ने रिकॉर्ड ब्रेक करते हुए महज 15 दिन में ही 1500 करोड़ रुपए की कमाई कर ली है, जो किसी भी इंडियन फिल्म के लिए बड़ी सफलता है. ‘उर्री’ डायरेक्टर आदित्य धर और रणवीर सिंह के लिए ये किसी माइलस्टोन से कम नहीं है. रियल लाइफ इवेंट से इंस्पायर इस फिल्म में रणवीर सिंह के साथ संजय दत्त, अक्षय खन्ना, आर माधवन, अर्जुन रामपाल, सारा अर्जुन और राकेश बेदी जैसे मंझे हुए कलाकार नजर आए हैं, जिन्होंने अपनी जबरदस्त स्क्रीन प्रजेंस से आग लगा दी. #Dhurandhar #Dhurandhar2 #DhurandharTheRevenge #BoxOffice #RanveerSingh

India’s boardrooms are growing — but the gender gap isn’t closing fast enough. Over the past decade, the share of female business directors in India has risen from 23.4% to 29.1%. That’s progress but at this pace, parity remains distant. These numbers don’t just reflect opportunity, they reflect the constraints shaping it. Women in India continue to face structural barriers to formal business leadership — from limited access to finance and legal identity, to deeply embedded social norms around who belongs in positions of authority. 👉Data from the World Bank Entrepreneurship Database, which tracks trends across 100+ economies, “defines business directors as individuals who lead newly registered limited liability companies in a given year”. The data shows that globally, the picture is uneven. Countries like South #Africa, #Thailand, and the #Philippines are approaching gender parity in business directorship. In contrast, economies such as #China and #Nigeria show gaps exceeding 40%. ➡️ #India is somewhere in the middle, while it has momentum, the task now is to make that progress structural, not cyclical by addressing the underlying constraints that shape women’s entry into and persistence in business leadership. The real question isn’t just how many women are becoming business directors but what systemic conditions are enabling or reversing that progress. #WomenInBusiness #GenderEquality #DataInsights #WomenEntrepreneurs #PublicPolicy #ICRIER #EPWD

W 2025 r. nakłady na kardiologię wyniosły 10 707 634 760 zł, a dodatkowo ponad 2,65 mld zł KPO jest rozdysponowane na 376 szpitali w całej Polsce w ramach Krajowej Sieci Kardiologicznej, by pacjenci mogli korzystać z nowoczesnego sprzętu, infrastruktury i zaawansowanych procedur medycznych. 🏥 Niezwykle cieszą nas takie informacje jak ta, która przyszła do nas z @nikardiologii, gdzie przeprowadzono przełomowy zabieg. Lekarze wszczepili dwa bezelektrodowe stymulatory serca, jeden w przedsionku, drugi w komorze, a następnie połączyli je zdalnie, tak aby współpracowały jak jeden system. Drugi stymulator wprowadzono przez żyłę szyjną, co dodatkowo ograniczyło ryzyko powikłań i zwiększyło bezpieczeństwo pacjentki. 👏🏻 To pierwszy taki zabieg w Polsce i przykład kierunku rozwoju współczesnej kardiologii - bardziej precyzyjnej, mniej inwazyjnej i opartej na nowoczesnych technologiach, stosowanych w najbardziej zaawansowanych ośrodkach na świecie.

TRADISYUNAL NA “SUNDO” NG SANTO SEPULCRO DE LA SANTA CRUZ, MULING IDINAOS Muling nasaksihan ng mga residente at deboto ang taunang tradisyunal na “sundo” ng Santo Sepulcro de la Santa Cruz patungo sa Santa Cruz Parish Church sa Marinduque bilang bahagi ng paggunita ng Mahal na Araw. Taon-taon, sama-samang lumalahok ang mga deboto sa nasabing gawain bilang pagpapakita ng kanilang malalim na pananampalataya at debosyon. Kasama ang imahe ng Santo Sepulcro, taimtim itong inihahatid mula sa pinanggalingan nito patungo sa simbahan, kasabay ng panalangin at pagninilay. Kapansin-pansin din ang presensya ng mga Morion na nakasuot ng makukulay at kakaibang maskara at kasuotan, na nagbibigay-buhay sa makulay na tradisyon ng Moriones Lenten Rites sa lalawigan ng Marinduque. Ayon sa ilang deboto, ang taunang “sundo” ay hindi lamang isang tradisyon kundi isang mahalagang bahagi ng kanilang pananampalataya na patuloy na isinasalin sa bawat henerasyon. Sa kabila ng paglipas ng panahon, nananatiling buhay ang ganitong mga gawain sa Santa Cruz, patunay ng matibay na pananalig at mayamang kulturang Marinduqueño. 📹:DIOMER DE LA ROSA DY Video

Over the past day, Russian forces have launched a dozen ballistic missiles at Ukraine, particularly at frontline regions—namely the Dnipropetrovsk and Kharkiv oblasts. There have been hits, and the attack is ongoing, Ukrainian Air Force Command's Yurii Ihnat said. He reported receiving information regarding the deployment of Tu-95 and Tu-160MS strategic bombers. Many drones have been detected in the Kirovohrad, Vinnytsia, and Cherkasy oblasts, and a large group of UAVs is moving south from Sumy Oblast. As of 7:00 a.m., approximately 240 drones had been detected; by 9:30 a.m., there were already over 400. There is also information about additional launches from various directions. Ihnat pointed to a “repeat of previous attacks,” similar to those on March 23–24 and from March 31 to April 1, when Russian forces attacked around the clock. He noted that the aggressor is using new routes and new drones, which they are constantly upgrading, as well as employing new tactics.

Iranian Fattah-1 Activates Second Motor and Defeats 12 Interceptors In this video, we can clearly see the missile activating its secondary solid-fuel motor. The Fattah-1 is a classic ballistic missile up to a certain point. It climbs into space on a high parabolic trajectory and re-enters the atmosphere at a steep angle. Up to that stage, it behaves like a conventional missile. The real difference lies in the activation of the re-entry motor and the movable nozzle, which allow it to make sharp corrections, zig-zag maneuvers in the terminal phase, or simply deliver a sudden burst of speed. Without this motor, a conventional warhead would lose more than 50% of its velocity when performing aggressive maneuvers due to atmospheric friction. The Fattah-1’s secondary motor is a small spherical solid-fuel engine, compact enough to fit inside the maneuverable re-entry vehicle (MaRV). Theoretically, it can burn for more than 30 seconds, counteracting atmospheric deceleration and ensuring the warhead strikes at hypersonic speeds. However, from what the video shows, it appears it can be reconfigured for a short, powerful boost of just a few seconds, delivering intense speed in the final phase. The developers claim that in this last stage, the missile reaches speeds above Mach 13. Of course, there’s no such thing as a perfect system. This secondary motor reduces the payload of the warhead due to space constraints, but that loss can be partially compensated by the massive increase in kinetic impact energy. Video

1. #CutTheClutter steps away from the war in the Gulf. It’s not about what’s happening in the battlefield, but its consequences, particularly for the ordinary Indian citizen — specifically the distress over LPG. This episode looks at India’s LPG & LNG imports, consumption and production. 2. If the war continues, other stress points, like fuel prices, will emerge. For now, there’s elections, but April 28 onwards, watch out for those prices. The reason is quite simple: India imports almost 90% of its crude oil needs. And, if anything, our production has been falling for the past many years, since 2011. 3. India is heavily dependent on imports for LPG. We have 32cr households that use LPG, but we produce only about 30-35%. And, nearly 90% of our imports is from the Gulf — UAE (36.5%), Qatar (21.4%), Kuwait (16%) & Saudi Arabia (14%). Most of our domestic production is as a byproduct of crude distillation at oil refineries, which govt has now asked to be increased. 4. On PNG, India is better placed. Only 1.5cr households use it & we also produce about 50%. Some of it comes from the Krishna Godavari basin, where a couple of more wells are being dug & the hope is that gas production will go up. But PNG is available elsewhere in the world, so India is not so dependent on the Gulf countries. 5. The govt assures us every day that they have enough LPG, the arrival of every tanker is celebrated in headlines. It’s almost like the 1960s. Then there were news items on front pages saying 2 more ships with wheat have arrived from the US. That was a ship-to-mouth existence. Today, it’s tanker-to-burner. 6. Parts of the world that produce hydrocarbons are prone to instability, so this uncertainty will continue — it’s already hit 5 times in my lifetime. Every 10-15 years, there will be an energy crisis in the world. So, how does a country like India get around it? 7. Participants, known as Morions, dress as Roman soldiers, sporting intricately crafted helmets and colorful masks inspired by the historical morrion. They parade through the streets and perform dramatic reenactments that tell the story of Longinus, the Roman centurion who is believed to have regained his sight after witnessing the crucifixion of Jesus. Kemp সিনেটের এক আনুষ্ঠানিক অধিবেশনে সেনাবাহিনী প্রধানের নিকট এ সম্মাননা তুলে দেন। জর্জিয়া স্টেট সিনেট রিপাবলিকান ও ডেমোক্রেট উভয় দলের সমর্থনে গৃহীত এই রেজ্যুলেশনের মাধ্যমে বিশ্বব্যাপী জাতিসংঘ শান্তিরক্ষা মিশনে কর্মরত বাংলাদেশি শান্তিরক্ষীদের গুরুত্বপূর্ণ অবদানকে আনুষ্ঠানিকভাবে স্বীকৃতি ও প্রশংসা জানায়। এই রেজুলেশন প্রণয়নে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ ভূমিকা পালন করেন বাংলাদেশী বংশোদ্ভূত সিনেটর শেখ রহমান। এর আগে মঙ্গলবার সকালে সেনাবাহিনী প্রধান জর্জিয়ার গভর্নর Mr. Brian P. Kemp এর সঙ্গে তাঁর দপ্তরে সাক্ষাৎ করেন। দ্বিপাক্ষিক এ বৈঠকে তাঁরা সামরিক সংক্রান্ত বিভিন্ন বিষয়ে আলোচনা করেন। অতঃপর, সেনাপ্রধানের নেতৃত্বে বাংলাদেশ প্রতিনিধিদল সিনেট অধিবেশনে অংশগ্রহণ করে। এ সময় তিনি জর্জিয়ার লেফটেন্যান্ট গভর্নর Mr. Burt Jones এর সঙ্গেও সাক্ষাৎ করেন। উল্লেখ্য, গত ২৮ মার্চ ২০২৬ তারিখে সরকারি সফরে সেনাবাহিনী প্রধান যুক্তরাষ্ট্র গমন করেছেন।

I'm not dissing @IntCyberDigest. What he wrote appears to be factually accurate. I don't think he is being misleading. My dumb little opinion piece was written to be more educational toward non-cybersecurity people because I think it's important to emphasize what this sort of compromise means and what the Threat Actors are capable (or incapable) of doing.

Yeah, so pretty much @IntCyberDigest got wind of Adobe allegedly* being compromised by a Threat Actor operating under the moniker Mr. Racoon, by all accounts it appears this compromise is legitimate. However, I believe there are some caveats that need to be emphasized to avoid confusion. Adobe's internal networks were not compromised. Adobe had their helpdesk system compromised. Yes, both are Adobe, but a compromise to helpdesk support is different than a network compromise. Adobe, like many other large companies, intentionally segregates different business components. A network compromise could potentially impact the organization itself, proprietary source code, etc. A helpdesk compromise will likely unveil sensitive information on users. In simpler terms, anyone who submitted a helpdesk ticket to Adobe, or requested assistance in any capacity, could be impacted. However, the scope of impact is unknown at this time. It is being reported that 13,000,000 support tickets have been exfiltrated, but that could be anything from a simple question to something more consequential like billing questions. Furthermore, we don't know how far these support tickets to back. But 13 million is an astronomically large number. A closing thought on this is that this compromise was the result of a BPO employee (outsourced labor). This BPO employee (according to the Threat Actor) was infected with malware, they WERE NOT an Insider Threat. Once the BPO employee was compromised the Threat Actors pivoted by phishing a manager. More information is needed, Adobe will likely make a statement later (or not depending on what their legal team suggests). It has been a very dramatic week in cybersecurity

🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿🇬🇧 Before 1830, nobody had a lawn. The rich had their grass cut by scythemen. Ordinary people had no garden worth speaking of. Edwin Budding was an engineer in Stroud, Gloucestershire. Working in a textile mill, he noticed a machine using a cutting cylinder to trim the surface of cloth. He looked at it. And thought about grass. He built a machine with a cutting cylinder mounted on a wheeled frame. Then pushed it across his garden at midnight. At midnight. So the neighbours wouldn't see. It worked. He patented it in August 1830. Within twenty years the Victorian suburb was born. The striped lawn. The neat garden. The Sunday morning ritual. Every suburban garden in America. Every cricket ground. Every football pitch. Every golf course on earth. Traces back to one man. In Stroud. With a cloth machine. At midnight. Right now, somewhere in the world, someone is cutting their grass. Robert is thirty-six years old. In 1247, this is not young. Robert knows this. His knees know this. His back has known this since approximately 1239. Robert lives in a village in Worcestershire with his wife Agnes, three surviving children, and two chickens he is not allowed to eat because the chickens produce eggs and the eggs matter more than the chickens. Today is a Tuesday in March. Robert will describe it as a Tuesday in March. The concept of a 'week' as a unit of leisure is not yet something Robert has access to. 5:00am - Up. Pottage on the fire. The pottage is oats, leeks, and some dried parsnip from the autumn store. There is a small piece of salted pork in it, approximately the size of Robert's thumb. It is mostly flavouring. Robert eats around it for as long as possible, then eats it, then thinks about it for the rest of the morning. 6:00am - Field. Robert works the lord's strip first, then his own. The ground is still cold. His boots have a hole. He has had the hole since October. He has packed it with rags. The rags are wet. They will remain wet until June. Robert is technically eating a plant-based diet. He is not doing this by choice. He is doing this because meat belongs to the lord, the deer belong to the king's forest, and the last man in this village who was caught with an unlicensed rabbit spent a period in the stocks that his family still doesn't fully discuss. 10:00am - Brief rest. Rye bread, hard. A small onion. Robert thinks about the pig that was slaughtered in November. He thinks about this often. The memory of fat is a specific and enduring thing when you don't have much of it. 1:00pm - Back to the field. Robert's average daily calorie intake is somewhere between 1,500 and 2,000 calories, the majority from grain. He is doing agricultural labour that modern exercise scientists would classify as extremely high intensity. He is, measurably, running on insufficient fuel. He is aware of this in the way that you are aware of things that cannot be changed: completely, and without drama. 4:00pm - Home. Agnes has made more pottage. It is similar to this morning's pottage. Robert eats it. Robert's teeth hurt. They have hurt for two years. There is no dentist. There is a barber-surgeon in the market town seven miles away. Robert cannot afford the barber-surgeon and cannot take the day from the fields. His teeth continue to hurt. 7:00pm - Sleep. Robert will be awake again at five. He is thirty-six. He will probably not see forty. The leading cause of death for men in his position is a combination of infection, injury, and the slow arithmetic of malnutrition across a lifetime. Somewhere, eight hundred years from now, someone will describe Robert's diet as "ancestral," "plant-forward," and "aligned with the earth." Robert would have a great deal to say about this. Robert does not have the energy.

As the United States wages war with Iran, much of Washington has been consumed with a geopolitical debate about what it will mean for America’s strategic competition with China. But this abstract debate belies the harsh realities now facing governments, firms, and people across Asia—the very region that Washington’s strategic class views as the cockpit of competition with Beijing. As I write today in this short essay for @CarnegieEndow the war threatens budgets, welfare programs, and ordinary livelihoods in Asia, a deeper and potentially existential set of challenges that seem sure to influence perceptions of whether and how American goals and interests intersect in the real world with the region’s priorities and its people’s daily realities. And we cannot just talk about U.S. strategy, posture, and especially staying power in the region as if these choices won’t affect perceptions and outcomes, and thus endure even after the bombs stop falling. The United States ignores the region’s lived experience—and the tough political and social trade-offs the war has produced—at its peril. carnegieendowment.org/emissa…

According to the agency, a judge heard their claims and found them "not to be valid." DHS told CBS News both Ali and Adel received final orders of removal in spring of 2025, adding that they received "full due process" and are currently in ICE custody until their removal. Both men are appealing the earlier decisions on their immigration cases.

Two gay Iranian men seeking asylum in the U.S. over fears of execution by the Iranian regime are facing an uncertain future because the U.S. government is not providing any clarity on whether they can be deported back to a war zone if their asylum cases are unsuccessful. Ali and Adel, whose names have been changed to protect their identities, crossed into the U.S. from Mexico in early 2025, right before the second Trump administration came into office. The men faced charges in Iran over their LGBTQ identities. Since arriving in the U.S., Ali and Adel have been held in "horrific" detention conditions, mistreated by guards and outed to other detainees, their legal representative told CBS News’ @haleyjoelleott. The ASEAN-Japan Workshop on Compound Geohazards under the ASEAN Science, Technology, and Innovation (STI) Platform for Disaster and Climate Resilience, Intervation Session Series, was successfully implemented on 30–31 March 2026 in Tsukuba, Japan. Hosted by the National Research Institute for Earth Science and Disaster Resilience (NIED), Japan, in partnership with COSTI Philippines, the programme gathered 55 delegates from 11 ASEAN Member States, the ASEAN Secretariat, and Japan. This two-day workshop directly supports a key action outlined in the ASEAN Plan of Action on Science, Technology and Innovation (APASTI) 2026–2035, which is leveraging STI in advancing disaster risk mitigation through strategic partnership. Participants also visited NIED’s simulation facilities—among the world’s largest and most advanced—demonstrating cutting-edge capabilities with strong potential impact for disaster preparedness across ASEAN. A key outcome was the proposal for a Multi-Hazard Early Warning System for ASEAN, powered by advanced technology and seamless interoperability of existing systems to strengthen regional resilience. We're open-sourcing more of our stack: iron-proxy, a default-deny egress proxy for untrusted workloads. It's been a bad month for supply chain security. Trivy, KICS, LiteLLM, and Axios all followed the same playbook: compromise a package, harvest env vars, exfiltrate secrets to a C2 server. Your CI runner, your agents, and your sandboxes all have real keys. iron-proxy sits between your workload and the internet. Workloads get proxy tokens. iron-proxy swaps in real credentials at the network boundary. If a compromised dependency exfiltrates your API key, it gets a token that's worthless outside the proxy. It's how we secure our VMs at iron[.]sh. The only way out is making sure there are no real secrets to steal. GitHub: github.com/ironsh/iron-proxy

This is the shot you can’t get from the press site. This camera was sitting a few football fields from the SLS rocket at Pad 39B for days before launch, baking in the Florida sun, surviving rain, humidity, and whatever else the Cape threw at it. No photographer behind the viewfinder. Just a camera, a sound trigger, and a bet. The way pad remotes work: you set your camera up days in advance, dial in your composition, lock everything down, and walk away. You don’t touch it again until after the launch. The shutter fires on sound activation with a @MiopsTrigger smart+ trigger. With SLS, the four RS-25 engines ignite six seconds before the solid rocket boosters, so the camera is already firing before the vehicle even leaves the pad. You get home, pull the card, and find out if you nailed it or if a bird landed on your lens two days ago and left your a present and you got 400 photos of soemthing crappy. There’s no formula for protecting your gear this close. Some photographers build wooden boxes with doors that pop open. Some use plastic bags and tape. Some do plastic or metal barn door rigs on hinges. I tend to leave mine open just in plastic rain covers because boxes limit my composition and setup time, but that means your cameras are more exposed to the elements and whatever energy and debris comes off the pad. You’re basically gambling a camera body every time you set one. That’s what I love about this genre. There’s no playbook. You make it up as you go. Every time is an adventure. 📸 credit: me for @SuperclusterHQ - Artemis II pad remote | ~1,000 ft from Pad 39B | Kennedy Space Center

#EventHighlights Punjab and Haryana’s agricultural model stands at a critical juncture — with slowing growth, environmental stress, and stagnant farmer incomes calling for urgent transformation. At the recent colloquium hosted by ICRIER, Centre for Research in Rural and Industrial Development (CRRID), and Chandigarh Citizens Foundation (CCF), policymakers and experts came together to chart a sustainable and income-augmenting path forward. Key Takeaways: 🔹 Diversification is critical – Moving beyond the rice-wheat system towards high-value crops like fruits, vegetables, pulses, and oilseeds can boost farmer incomes and sustainability. 🔹 Growth through innovation – As highlighted by Dr Ramesh Chand, strategic diversification could raise agricultural growth to nearly 5%. 🔹 Markets hold the key – Dr Sukhpal Singh emphasised that enabling market access and strengthening institutions is essential for making diversification viable. 🔹 Sustainability & farmers' incomes must go hand-in-hand – Protecting natural resources while improving livelihoods remains central to policy priorities, as noted by Smt. Vini Mahajan. 🔹 Smart policy incentives can drive change – As presented by Dr Ashok Gulati, repurposing subsidies to support shifts towards pulses and oilseeds can reduce environmental stress while remaining fiscally viable. The colloquium also marked the release of ICRIER's report titled "Diversification to Augment Farmers' Incomes and Promote Sustainable Agriculture in Punjab and Haryana", co-authored by Dr Reena Singh, Ms Purvi Thangaraj, and Dr Ashok Gulati. A newly-appointed Ambassador of the Republic of Poland to ASEAN, H.E. Barbara Szymanowska, today presented her Letter of Credence to the Secretary-General of ASEAN, Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, at the ASEAN Headquarters/ASEAN Secretariat, marking the assumption of her post as the Ambassador of the Republic of Poland to ASEAN. Secretary-General Dr. Kao congratulated Ambassador Szymanowska on her new role and reaffirmed the ASEAN Secretariat’s readiness to work closely with her and the Embassy of the Republic of Poland in Jakarta to further strengthen cooperation between both sides. He encouraged Poland to explore cooperation opportunities with ASEAN in areas of mutual interest, including education and people-to-people exchanges, digital economy, green transition, parliamentary cooperation, tourism, and trade and investment. Ambassador Szymanowska highlighted the growing significance of ASEAN in Poland’s foreign policy, as manifested in its diplomatic presence and parliamentary cooperation in the region. She expressed Poland’s readiness to sign the Treaty of Amity and Cooperation in Southeast Asia (TAC) under the Philippines’ ASEAN Chairship this year, which will further signify Poland’s commitment to enhancing its partnership with ASEAN and its Member States. Poland appointed its first Ambassador to ASEAN in 2012. Ambassador Szymanowska succeeds Ambassador Beata Stoczyńska, who concluded her tenure in June 2024.

क्रिकेट (SLC) के खिलाफ अदालत का दरवाजा खटखटाया है. उन्हें मौजूदा आईपीएल 2026 सीजन के लिए अपनी टीम से जुड़ने से रोका जा रहा है, जिसके विरोध में उन्होंने यह केस दायर किया है. रजत पाटीदार की कप्तानी वाली आरसीबी टीम के लिए तुषारा इस सीजन में एक महत्वपूर्ण कड़ी माने जा रहे थे, क्योंकि अनुभवी गेंदबाज जोश हेजलवुड शुरुआती मैचों के लिए फिट नहीं हैं. ऐसे में तुषारा की अनुपस्थिति टीम के लिए एक बड़ा रणनीतिक झटका साबित हो सकती है. श्रीलंका क्रिकेट गवर्निंग बॉडी ने तुषारा को अनापत्ति प्रमाण पत्र (NOC) देने से साफ इनकार कर दिया है. बोर्ड का तर्क है कि यह 31 वर्षीय गेंदबाज 'निर्धारित फिटनेस मानकों' पर खरा नहीं उतरा है. गौरतलब है कि इस साल कई श्रीलंकाई सितारों को इसी तरह की समस्याओं का सामना करना पड़ा है. कोलकाता नाइटराइडर्स (KKR) के 18 करोड़ के खिलाड़ी मथीशा पथिराना और स्पिन स्टार वानिंदु हसरंगा को भी टी20 वर्ल्ड कप 2026 के दौरान लगी चोटों के कारण अभी तक एनओसी नहीं दी गई है. . . श्रीलंकाई मीडिया आउटलेट 'न्यूजवायर' की रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, तुषारा ने कोलंबो जिला अदालत में एनओसी न देने के फैसले को चुनौती दी है. इस मामले की प्रारंभिक सुनवाई आज हुई और अगली सुनवाई 9 अप्रैल के लिए निर्धारित की गई है. तुषारा ने अपनी याचिका में श्रीलंका क्रिकेट के अध्यक्ष शम्मी सिल्वा, सचिव बंडुला दिसानायके, कोषाध्यक्ष सुजीवा गोडलियाड्डा और सीईओ एशले डी सिल्वा को प्रतिवादी (defendants) के रूप में नामित किया है. खिलाड़ी का मानना है कि बोर्ड का यह फैसला अनुचित है और उनके करियर को प्रभावित कर रहा है. इस पूरे विवाद में सबसे दिलचस्प बात यह है कि तुषारा को कोई शारीरिक चोट नहीं है. श्रीलंकाई बोर्ड ने केवल उनके 'फिटनेस मानक' पर सवाल उठाए हैं. दूसरी ओर, तुषारा ने अपनी रिपोर्ट में स्पष्ट किया है कि उनका फिटनेस स्तर उनके पूरे करियर के दौरान एक जैसा रहा है और इससे पहले उन्हें कभी भी एनओसी देने से नहीं रोका गया. रिपोर्ट यह भी दावा करती है कि तुषारा का केंद्रीय अनुबंध 31 मार्च को समाप्त हो गया था और वह इसे आगे नहीं बढ़ाना चाहते हैं. उन्होंने बोर्ड को अंतरराष्ट्रीय क्रिकेट से दूरी बनाने की अपनी योजना के बारे में भी पहले ही बता दिया है. #IPL #IPL2026 #RCB #RoyalChallengersBangalore

This early uptick aligns with PIDE’s latest working paper,“𝐄𝐱𝐩𝐨𝐬𝐮𝐫𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐚 𝐒𝐭𝐫𝐚𝐢𝐭 𝐨𝐟 𝐇𝐨𝐫𝐦𝐮𝐳 𝐒𝐡𝐨𝐜𝐤: 𝐅𝐮𝐞𝐥 𝐏𝐫𝐢𝐜𝐢𝐧𝐠, 𝐈𝐧𝐟𝐥𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐄𝐱𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐧𝐚𝐥 𝐕𝐮𝐥𝐧𝐞𝐫𝐚𝐛𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐲” by Dr. Ahsan ul Haq Satti (@sattiahsan1) and Dr. S. M. Naeem Nawaz (@SMNaeemNawaz). The study shows that even a mild external shock could push inflation to 7.36% in the first month, with further increases in subsequent months. 𝐊𝐞𝐲 𝐈𝐧𝐬𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭 The real risk lies not just in the initial shock, but in the persistent pass-through via energy, transport, and food prices—making inflation structurally sticky and harder to control. বাংলাদেশ-তুরস্ক ৪র্থ আর্মি ষ্টাফ টকস (AST) ২০২৬ এর সফল সমাপ্তি ঢাকা, ০২ এপ্রিল ২০২৬ (বৃহস্পতিবার): আজ (০২ এপ্রিল ২০২৬) ঢাকা সেনানিবাসের আর্মি মাল্টিপারপাস কমপ্লেক্সে ৩০ মার্চ ২০২৬ হতে ০২ এপ্রিল ২০২৬ তারিখ পর্যন্ত ০৪ দিনব্যাপী বাংলাদেশ-তুরস্ক ৪র্থ আর্মি স্টাফ টকস (AST) ২০২৬ এর সফল সমাপ্তি হয়েছে। এই উচ্চপর্যায়ের বৈঠকে উভয় দেশের সেনাবাহিনীর প্রতিনিধিরা অংশ নেন এবং তাদের মধ্যে পারস্পরিক সহযোগিতা বৃদ্ধির জন্য নানা গুরুত্বপূর্ণ বিষয় নিয়ে ফলপ্রসূ আলোচনা হয়। বাংলাদেশের পক্ষে আলোচনায় ১৮ সদস্যের প্রতিনিধিদল অংশগ্রহণ করেন, যার নেতৃত্ব দেন বাংলাদেশ সেনাবাহিনীর সামরিক প্রশিক্ষণ পরিদপ্তরের পরিচালক ব্রিগেডিয়ার জেনারেল মোঃ হুমায়ূন কবীর, এসইউপি (বার), এসপিপি, এনডিসি, পিএসসি, এমফিল। তুরস্কের পক্ষে অংশগ্রহণকারী ৩ সদস্যের প্রতিনিধিদলের নেতৃত্ব দেন তুরস্কের হেড অব মিলিটারি রিলেশন্স এন্ড স্ট্র্যাটেজি ডিপার্টমেন্টের কর্নেল কাদের ওজিউরেক। এই আলোচনা পর্বে উভয় পক্ষই সামরিক সহযোগিতা, দক্ষতা বৃদ্ধি এবং কৌশলগত সহযোগিতার বিভিন্ন দিক নিয়ে বিস্তর আলোচনা করেন। আলোচনায় উভয় পক্ষের মধ্যে প্রশিক্ষণ আদান-প্রদান, উন্নত প্রযুক্তি ও সামরিক সরঞ্জাম ব্যবহারের সক্ষমতা বৃদ্ধি এবং পারস্পারিক সহযোগিতার উপর গুরুত্বারোপ করা হয়। বিশেষ করে, সামরিক সক্ষমতা বৃদ্ধির জন্য একাধিক যৌথ প্রশিক্ষণ ও মহড়ার আয়োজন, উদ্ভাবনী প্রশিক্ষণ পদ্ধতি এবং আরও কার্যকর যৌথ সহযোগিতা নিয়ে বিস্তারিত আলোচনা করা হয়। সেনাবাহিনী এবং সামরিক কৌশলের ক্ষেত্রে এই ধরনের বৈঠক উভয় দেশের প্রতিরক্ষা খাতে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ অগ্রগতি সাধনের পথ সুগম করবে বলে আশা করা যায়।

#OpEd West Bengal's welfare schemes are being funded not from growth dividends, but from borrowed money. Ashok Gulati and Bidisha Chanda put it plainly in today's op-ed: today's freebies are tomorrow's fiscal crisis. But Bengal doesn't need to start from scratch to get ahead. It is already a leading producer of vegetables: cabbage, brinjal, cauliflower, pointed gourd. It hosts 88 of India's 118 jute mills. It grows Darjeeling tea, one of the most globally recognisable agricultural brands in the world. The production base is there. What's missing is serious agro-processing investment, functional value chains, and the political will to back private capital over populist transfers. A PepsiCo doing contract farming with potato farmers. Processors building pipelines into high-value domestic and export markets. That's the model this op-ed points to, and it's not far-fetched for Bengal. It's just unfunded and deprioritised. असिस्टेंट कमांडेंट अजय मलिक जी ने नक्सली मुठभेड़ के दौरान IED ब्लास्ट में अपना एक पैर खो दिया - देश की रक्षा में सब कुछ दांव पर लगा दिया। और इस बलिदान के बदले मिला क्या? 15 साल से अधिक की निष्ठापूर्ण सेवा के बावजूद - प्रमोशन नहीं, अपनी ही फोर्स को लीड करने का अधिकार नहीं। क्योंकि सभी शीर्ष पद IPS अफसरों के लिए आरक्षित हैं। यह सिर्फ एक अफसर की पीड़ा नहीं - यह लाखों CAPF जवानों के साथ हो रहा संस्थागत अन्याय है। ये जवान सीमाओं पर तैनात रहते हैं, आतंक और नक्सलवाद से लोहा लेते हैं, लोकतंत्र के उत्सव चुनावों को सुरक्षित बनाते हैं। लेकिन जब इनके अधिकार और सम्मान की बात आती है, तो व्यवस्था मुँह फेर लेती है। खुद CAPF के जवान इस भेदभाव के विरुद्ध हैं। सुप्रीम कोर्ट तक ने इस व्यवस्था पर सवाल उठाए हैं। फिर भी, वर्तमान सरकार इसी अन्याय को कानूनी रूप से स्थायी बनाने पर आमादा है। यह विधेयक केवल एक करियर रोकने का प्रयास नहीं - यह उन लोगों का मनोबल तोड़ने की कोशिश है जो देश की पहली रक्षा पंक्ति हैं। और जब उनका मनोबल टूटता है, तो राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा की नींव हिलती है। हम CAPF के जवानों का सम्मान सिर्फ शब्दों में नहीं, नीतियों में करते हैं। कांग्रेस का साफ वादा है - हमारी सरकार आते ही यह भेदभावपूर्ण कानून समाप्त होगा। क्योंकि जो देश के लिए लड़ता है, उसे नेतृत्व का अधिकार मिलना ही चाहिए। Video

In #Peru’s San Martín Region, COOPBAM – a cooperative of coffee and cocoa producers from Awajún Indigenous communities – shows how targeted finance can turn smallholder production into a bankable, export‑oriented business. Supported by the IFAD-financed Avanzar Rural Programme, the cooperative has upgraded collection, quality control and marketing systems to reach specialty and international markets. COOPBAM is one of many producer organizations that have invested in market-oriented business plans under Avanzar Rural, with nearly 14,000 members now linked to formal buyers and higher-value markets. Youth and women’s participation exceeded targets, and hundreds of organizations have improved branding, packaging and sanitary registration – concrete steps that reduce transaction costs and mitigate risk. Recently ranked IFAD’s best‑performing active project worldwide in 2024, Avanzar Rural demonstrates that a territorially anchored, cooperative‑centred model can deliver scalable, climate‑resilient rural growth – and provide a clear pipeline of investable rural enterprises for public and private capital. A newly-appointed Ambassador of the Republic of Slovenia to ASEAN, H.E. Smiljana Knez, today presented her Letter of Credence to the Secretary-General of ASEAN, Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, at the ASEAN Headquarters/ASEAN Secretariat, marking the assumption of her post as the non-resident Ambassador of the Republic of Slovenia to ASEAN, based in Manila, the Philippines. Secretary-General Dr. Kao congratulated Ambassador Knez on her new role and reaffirmed the ASEAN Secretariat’s readiness to work closely with her and the Embassy of the Republic of Slovenia in Manila to further strengthen cooperation between ASEAN and Slovenia. He encouraged Slovenia to continue deepening existing cooperation and to explore untapped opportunities with ASEAN in areas of mutual interest, including in artificial intelligence (AI), logistics, pharmaceuticals, tourism as well as people-to-people and business-to-business linkages. Ambassador Knez highlighted that the opening of the Embassy of the Republic of Slovenia in Manila, in March 2025, as its first diplomatic mission in the region, and its request to accede to the Treaty of Amity and Cooperation in Southeast Asia (TAC), reflect Slovenia’s commitment to strengthening its political ties and deepening cooperation with ASEAN in key areas, such as trade, green transition, digital economy, and connectivity. Slovenia appointed its first non-resident Ambassador to ASEAN in 2011. Ambassador Knez succeeded Ambassador Marko Ham, who was previously based in Canberra and concluded his tenure in December 2025.
